summary: Iteration 64 — P0 features (capability-based login routing, PWA safe-area, privacy toggle, ShiftScheduler local drafts + role-dependent off-labels) verified end-to-end. 5/5 backend pytest tests PASSED. 6/6 frontend smoke checks PASSED. No console errors. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: /scheduler/blocks returns a nested dict shape `{staff_id: {YYYY-MM-DD: {block_type, reason, leave_id, bulk_week_off, set_by_admin}}}` — undocumented from POV of testers. Consider adding response_model or OpenAPI annotation for future API consumers.

attendance.py L574: manager exception treats `current_user.role=='admin' OR 'workforce.manage_rota' in capabilities` as manager. Correct, but `current_user.capabilities` may be None on legacy users — covered by `or []` fallback. OK.

ShiftScheduler client-side drafts: when user clicks Publish, three sequential POST calls happen per draft (mark-day-off, mark-week-off, publish). If any single mark fails mid-flight, partial state may be committed — consider transactional/batch endpoint for ≥10 drafts. Acceptable for typical scheduler usage.

shifts.py L228: `leave_type: data.reason or 'week_off'` overrides intended default — if caller sends reason='personal' (unlikely now since UI removed it) the leave_type becomes 'personal' rather than 'week_off'. Cosmetic since UI filtered it. Same pattern for mark-day-off L310.

Privacy toggle returns hidden_by_admin=true with all numerics=0. UI hides Pay tab via /restaurants/my call + /attendance/my-summary call. Two-source-of-truth — keep them in sync. If admin toggles ON while staff is mid-session, staff still sees stale Pay tab until next /restaurants/my fetch. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Created and self-cleaned: 1 manager-cap staff (TEST_mgr_<ts>), 1 day-off leave_request (30d future, then cleared), 1 bulk_week_off leave (60d future, then cleared). Privacy toggle reset to OFF after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form selectors are placeholder-based: input[placeholder='you@company.com'] for username and input[placeholder='Enter password']. /scheduler/blocks shape is nested dict {staff_id:{date:{block_type, set_by_admin, bulk_week_off,...}}}. ShiftScheduler renders day-off- and draft-off- data-testids per cell — selectors use prefix match ^=. Publish button label dynamically updates to 'Publish · N pending' on drafts. SKAdmin sees Pay tab in Heva Ops bottom nav (correct — admin is manager). Workforce-only staff without manage_rota cap would have Pay tab hidden when admin toggle is ON — not directly verified in this run as we don't have a workforce-only test account.
verified_flows: BACKEND: PUT /restaurants/my/settings persists business_info.hide_pay_and_hours_from_employees=true|false and GET /restaurants/my reflects it
BACKEND: /attendance/my-summary as `user` returns hidden_by_admin=true + all numerics 0 + empty arrays when toggle ON; reverts to normal data when OFF
BACKEND: Manager-cap (workforce.manage_rota) staff bypasses the hide — hidden_by_admin falsy and hourly_rate preserved (15) even with toggle ON
BACKEND: POST /shifts/mark-day-off + /shifts/mark-week-off persist set_by_admin=true; /scheduler/blocks exposes set_by_admin=true on hard blocks (and bulk_week_off=true for week-off, 7 days)
FRONTEND: /settings → Business Info tab shows data-testid='hide-pay-toggle'

FRONTEND: /workforce/shifts — clicking [data-testid^='day-off-'] creates a draft-off-<sid>-<date> badge instantly, no API call; Publish button label becomes 'Publish · 1 pending'; clicking the draft badge undoes it without API call
FRONTEND: Heva Ops mobile layout (390x844) renders heva-ops-layout/header/tabs with safe-area classes (visible in screenshot); no overlap of bottom nav with content
FRONTEND: No 'Personal' string anywhere in /app/frontend/src/pages/ShiftScheduler.js (grep returned 0 matches)
FRONTEND: No console / page errors during any flow
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. Initial test failure was due to my parser misreading /scheduler/blocks response shape — fixed in the test, not the API. The API already correctly emits set_by_admin=true on day-off and 7×set_by_admin+bulk_week_off=true on week-off blocks.
